description: This file defines the ConnectionMonitor interface, which provides an abstraction for monitoring connection events such as success, failure, and exceptions within the org.eclipse.ditto.services.connectivity.messaging.monitoring package. It includes methods for logging, metrics recording, and wrapping execution blocks for monitoring purposes.

classes.name: ConnectionMonitor
classes.description: An interface outlining methods for logging, metrics, success, failure, exception handling, and execution wrapping to monitor connection events.

classes.name: WrappedConnectionMonitor
classes.description: An internal interface for wrapping execution blocks to monitor success or failure during code execution.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns the logger used by the monitor for logging connection events.

methods.name: getCounter
methods.description: Returns the metrics counter used for recording success and failure events.

methods.name: success
methods.description: Records a success event with various overloads accepting signals, external messages, info providers, messages, and arguments, logging and incrementing success counter.

methods.name: failure
methods.description: Records a failure event with overloads accepting signals, headers, external messages, info providers, messages, and exceptions, logging and incrementing failure counter.

methods.name: exception
methods.description: Records an exception event, logging details and optionally incrementing failure counter, accepting signals, external messages, info providers, messages, and exceptions.

methods.name: wrapExecution
methods.description: Wraps code execution with monitoring, returning a wrapped monitor that can execute runnables or suppliers, and handle success or failure states.
